approach: Analysis showed each frame/channel is a wrapped sine plane: fitted K_c + ISIN(aX+bY+p) per frame/channel by brute force, found linear phase in T and C; audio fitted as ISIN(N*k)<<s. K_c (250,87,149) replaced by a 7-byte formula found by exhaustive bottom-up enumeration (C enumerator); phase constant folded via NOT(T); audio uses SHL 6 instead of MUL 64.
